description: Defines the ImmutableString class, a wrapper for static or pool-allocated character arrays with guaranteed validity during compilation. Includes utility functions, hash functions, and comparison operators.

classes.name: ImmutableString
classes.description: A wrapper for static or pool-allocated null-terminated character arrays, providing comparison, hashing, and utility functions.
